newsitem.title: USA: Bluegreen Corp to acquire RDI Group Inc.
newsitem.headline: Bluegreen Corp to acquire RDI Group Inc.

text.p: Bluegreen Corp said Thursday it has agreed to acquire privately-owned RDI Group Inc, an owner of two timeshare resorts and manager of 30 vacation resorts.
Terms of the transaction were not disclosed, but Bluegreen said 80 percent of the purchase price will be financed through a convertible note issuance with two of its directors.
For the year ended September 30, 1996, RDI had revenues of over $26 million, said Bluegreen.
In recent months, Bluegreen said it has doubled its product offerings in the timeshare industry, adding another two timeshare resorts to its three existing ones.
In addition to its timeshare projects, the company is engaged in the acquisition, development, marketing and sale of residential land, mostly in the southeast and southwest U.S.
